summary: First-finish smoke test of Court Mastery basketball training app. Backend auth + program CRUD + session PATCH verified via curl. Full frontend E2E flow verified via Playwright: landing hero -> register -> dashboard -> build program -> program view (10 weeks) -> session view (3 drills, mark complete, save notes) -> completion reflected on program card + progress bar (1/10) -> logout -> protected route redirect. All data-testid selectors present and functional.
passed: GET / — landing page loads with 'Build A Player In 10 Weeks' hero and CTAs
POST /api/auth/register — returns 200 with JWT token; sets cookie
PATCH /api/programs/{id}/sessions/1 — 200, marks completed and saves notes
UI register flow lands on /dashboard and stores cm_token in localStorage
Dashboard empty state shows Build Program CTA
Builder form (player name + gender mens + skill developing + age slider) submits and redirects to /programs/:id
Mark Complete + Save Notes buttons work (session-complete-btn, session-notes-textarea, session-save-notes-btn)
Program view shows check icon on week 1 and Progress 1/10 after completion
Dashboard shows the created program card
Logout clears session and /dashboard redirects to /login when unauthenticated
notes: Console showed benign 401s during initial page load before token attached (auth/me pre-login checks) and 'No available adapters' warnings from YouTube iframes — non-blocking. Delete-program and admin login flows not exercised but non-critical for first finish.
